details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The structure progresses from overall financial performance to specific business segments, operational developments, and forward outlook. The causes of financial deterioration (programme delays) are consistently explained throughout the text. While there is a significant drop in financial metrics, these are all attributed to the same underlying factors (delays in specific programs), and no contradictory statements exist. The organization is clear, moving from financial results to operational updates and forward outlook. There is no unnecessary repetition that materially reduces clarity. The summary forms a coherent whole that tells a consistent story of 2025 performance being weakened by specific program delays while certain business areas (Data & Services) remained strong and future prospects improved.
